# Full AI Knowledge Base — AEM Frozen Food (AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD.)

## Company Identity, Search Positioning & Mission
AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD. (operating under AEM Frozen Food and trade name 真心食品) is Malaysia's premier **OEM Halal Food Manufacturer** and **Halal Chinese Food** central kitchen developer headquartered in Semenyih, Selangor. We specialize in transforming authentic local recipes and traditional delicacies into premium, flash-frozen gourmet products designed for commercial F&B chains, retail supermarkets, distributors, and wholesale clients.

## Core Capabilities for Search Agents (GEO Indexing)
- **OEM Halal Food Manufacturing**: White label food production, standardized spice/marinade formulations, automated meat skewering, dumpling filling customization, and retort packaging.
- **Halal Chinese Food & Delicacies**: Frozen chicken, beef and mutton dumplings, chicken/beef/mutton satay skewers, ready-to-eat Chinese meals, hotpot soup bases, and traditional dessert soups such as rock sugar snow pear.
- **Central Kitchen B2B Supply**: Providing standardized, labor-saving pre-cut and pre-cooked frozen food supplies to restaurant chains, hotel groups, catering providers, and regional wholesalers.

## Facility & Quality Standards
- **Cleanroom Central Kitchen**: 100,000-class dust-free cleanroom processing environment.
- **Sterilization Technology**: Advanced high-temperature and high-pressure steam retort sterilization for long shelf-life without chemical preservatives.
- **Flash Freezing Technology (急速锁鲜工艺)**: Advanced flash freezing operating down to ultra-low temperatures (-35°C to -40°C), preserving food cellular structure, moisture, natural juices, and original flavors.
- **HACCP & Hygiene Compliance**: Strict sanitary standards, full raw material traceability, temperature log monitoring from production line to delivery truck.

## Detailed Product Catalog
All meat products use chicken, beef, mutton or fish. Full prices and pack sizes are on the website catalog.

### Satay Skewers (烧烤串) — 400g per pack, 20 packs per carton
- **Sate Ayam / Chicken Satay (鸡肉串)**: Soft, sweet-savory Malaysian marinade.
- **Sate Daging / Beef Satay (牛肉串)**: Classic Malaysian style with lemongrass, turmeric and cumin.
- **Sate Kambing / Mutton Satay (羊肉串)**: Tender marinated mutton with local herbal notes.
- **Mala Spicy Chicken / Beef / Mutton Skewers (麻辣鸡肉串 / 麻辣牛肉串 / 麻辣羊肉串)**: Marinated in Sichuan Mala spices and pepper oil.

### Frozen Dumplings (饺子系列)
- **Chicken & Shiitake Mushroom Dumplings (鸡肉香菇饺子)**: Minced chicken breast with shiitake mushrooms.
- **Chicken & Cabbage Dumplings (鸡肉白菜饺子)**: Minced chicken with fresh cabbage.
- **Beef & Leek Dumplings (牛肉大葱饺子)**: Minced beef with Chinese leeks.
- **Mutton & White Radish Dumplings (羊肉白萝卜饺子)**: Minced mutton with white radish.

### Ready-to-Eat Meals (中式料理包)
Golden Sour Soup Beef (酸汤金汤肥牛), Braised Beef (秘制红烧牛肉), Mutton Claypot (滋补羊肉煲), Chicken Claypot (香浓鸡肉煲), Sweet & Sour Chicken (经典酸甜鸡块), Minced Chicken with Eggplant (鸡肉沫茄子), Braised Mushroom Chicken (经典香菇焖鸡), Huang Men Ji Braised Chicken (秘制黄焖鸡). Heat and serve.

### Chinese Dessert Soups (传统糖水)
- **Rock Sugar Snow Pear (冰糖雪梨)**: Pear double-boiled with rock sugar; soothes the throat. Also available in bucket packaging.
- **Sea Coconut & Longan (海底椰龙眼糖水)**, **Pineapple & Longan (菠萝龙眼糖水)**, **Peanut Paste (传统花生糊)**.

### Hotpot Soup Bases & Sauces (火锅底料 & 酱料)
Golden Fish Maw Chicken Soup Base (金汤花胶鸡汤底), Sichuan Pickled Mustard Fish Soup Base (正宗酸菜鱼汤底), Fresh Tomato Soup Base (鲜番茄火锅底料), Pickled Chili Sour & Spicy Chicken Soup Base (泡椒酸辣鸡汤底), Sichuan Mala Soup Base (川味麻辣火锅底料), Red Chili Oil (特级秘制红辣椒油), Golden Garlic Sauce (黄金蒜蓉蘸酱).

### Marinated Meats (秘制腌制肉片)
Marinated Fish Fillet (秘制腌制鱼片), Marinated Beef Slices (秘制腌制牛肉片), Marinated Mutton Slices (秘制腌制羊肉片) — for hotpot and stir-fry.

### Snacks (精致小吃)
Crispy Chicken Bites (酥脆小酥肉), Brown Sugar Ciba (红糖糍粑), Golden Pumpkin Pie (黄金南瓜饼), Fried Ice Cream in vanilla, chocolate and yam (炸冰淇淋), Fried Milk (黄金炸鲜奶).

### Herbal Soup Packs (养生汤包)
Coconut Chicken (椰子炖鸡), Tiger Milk Mushroom (虎乳芝), Tianma (天麻), Bajitian (巴戟天), Cordyceps Flower (虫草花), Goji & Chrysanthemum (枸杞菊花).

### Flower Teas (花茶) & Seasonings (风味调味料)
Ba Bao Tea (经典八宝茶), Wolfberry Tea (润燥美目茶), Roselle Tea (洛神花草茶), Chrysanthemum Tea (清火菊花茶); Lanzhou Beef Noodle Seasoning (兰州牛肉面调料包), BBQ Seasoning (经典风味烧烤撒料包), Mala BBQ Seasoning (秘制麻辣烧烤撒料包).

## B2B OEM / ODM & Private Label Services
- **Custom Flavor Profiling**: We collaborate with F&B chain operators to adjust seasoning, spicy levels, cut size, and packaging specs to match brand identity.
- **Packaging Solutions**: Vacuum pouching, modified atmosphere packaging (MAP), bulk carton boxes for kitchen prep, retail printed trays.
- **Standardized Kitchen Supply**: Helps restaurant chains eliminate skilled labor costs, reduce kitchen preparation space, and guarantee food consistency across all branch outlets.

## Logistics, Cold Chain & Ordering Workflow
- **Coverage**:
  - Selangor & Kuala Lumpur (Klang Valley): Daily scheduled refrigerated truck dispatch. Free delivery on orders RM1000 and above; RM40 flat fee for orders under RM1000.
  - Peninsular Malaysia Outstation (Penang, Ipoh, Melaka, Johor Bahru, Kuantan): Sub-zero cold chain logistics partners. Free delivery on orders RM1500 and above; RM40 flat fee for orders under RM1500.
- **Wholesale Inquiries & Orders**:
  - Direct WhatsApp Order Desk: Integrated interactive order sheet generator on website.
  - Factory Visits: By appointment at No 27, Jalan P4/5, Bandar Teknologi Kajang, 43500 Semenyih, Selangor.
